sentences.text: Kanha Industries Limited vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on

Author: Moushumi Bhattacharya
Bench: Moushumi Bhattacharya
03.11.2022
sayandeep
Sl. No. 12
Ct. No. 05
 Wpa 3477 of 2022
 Kanha Industries Limited
 -Versus-
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Kanishk Kejriwal
 Mr. Pranav Sharma
 .....for the petitioner
 Mr. Samrat Sen
 Mr. Subhendu Sengupta
 ......for the State
The petitioner has challenged an order passed by  the adjudicating officer dated 24th January, 2022.
By  the said order, the petitioner's food sample was found to  be sub-standard under The Food Safety and Standards  Act, 2006.
Learned A.A.A.G appearing for the State  respondents places Sections 68, 70 and 71 of the said Act to submit that the impugned order is appealable in nature.

Counsel further places orders of 10th January, 2022 and 17th January, 2022 issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department of the Government of West Bengal which show that a retired member of the West Bengal Judicial Services has joined as the Presiding Officer of the West Bengal Food Safety Tribunal under Section 70 of the Act from 3rd January, 2022.

sentences.text: Since the order placed before the Court show that the appellate Tribunal constituted under the Act is functioning as on date, the petitioner is given leave to approach the said Tribunal for adjudicating of the subject matter of the dispute.
WPA 3477 of 2022 is disposed of on the above basis.

(Moushumi Bhattacharya, J.)
